title: Wings live: Odeon, Birmingham | 1973
content:
Wings performed at the Odeon in Birmingham, England, on 6 July 1973.

It was the 16th night of the 18-date Wings 1973 UK Tour, which opened on 11 May in Bristol. The support act was Brinsley Schwarz.

This show was originally scheduled for May 27, but was postponed till the second leg of the tour. Tickets cost 60p, 80p, £1, £1.30, and £1.60.

Wings were Paul McCartney on vocals, guitar, and bass guitar; Linda McCartney on vocals and keyboards; Denny Laine on vocals, guitar, and bass guitar; Henry McCullough on guitar and vocals; and Denny Seiwell on drums.

The Beatles had performed at the Birmingham Odeon on 11 October 1964 and 9 December 1965. Wings returned for a final time on 12 December 1979.
